claim_title: Type II collagen supplementation reduces osteoarthritis pain and improves joint function
caption: **Collagen for joint pain.** The single reviewed study reported less knee pain and better function after 90 days, but it tested hydrolyzed bovine collagen peptides — not the Type II collagen this claim names. It also used tiny groups of about 20 people, ran dozens of comparisons without statistical correction, ignored exercise habits, and was funded by the manufacturer. These flaws mean the evidence can't confirm the claim.
subtitle: One small manufacturer-funded study tested a different collagen type.
